name: talkie
description: Query your local Talkie meetings, daily brief, context graph, and dictation history — on-device, no network.
long_description: Talkie's local MCP server exposes your meetings, today's brief, your personal context graph (people, projects, commitments), and your dictation history to Claude — 100% on-device. Nothing leaves your Mac. Reads are direct; the dictionary tools (add / update / remove vocabulary terms and replacement rules) only QUEUE a suggestion, which Talkie applies with a one-tap Undo — so a session can never silently change your speech recognition.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List recent meetings (id, title, date, duration, participants, one-line summary).

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get a meeting's full summary + transcript by id prefix, title match, or calendar day (yyyy-MM-dd).

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Today's on-device brief — what you worked on, commitments, open threads.

tools.name: list_commitments
tools.description: Commitments / action items extracted from your meetings (context graph), newest first. Nothing is ever marked done — treat these as things you said, not a task list.

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Look up people / projects / terms by name, with provenance.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic + keyword search across meetings, dictations, and entities — finds by meaning, not just substring.

tools.name: get_recent_context
tools.description: Recent context recall, with provenance, on-device — what you've been dictating, meeting about, and mentioning in the last N minutes, as a timestamped report. Pass a topic for recency-weighted related items.

tools.name: graph_query
tools.description: Recall what's known about one person / project / term, with provenance, on-device — header, recent snippets, and other entities seen in the same dictations or meetings.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: The user's lifetime Talkie dictation stats — words, dictations, speaking time, average/best WPM, fixes Talkie made, and current/longest daily streak — on-device (totals survive the 7-day history prune).

tools.name: get_dictionary
tools.description: List the user's Talkie dictionary — vocabulary terms and spoken→written replacement rules (learned rules tagged) — on-device; call before add_vocabulary_term or add_replacement so you don't suggest a duplicate.

tools.name: list_dictations
tools.description: List the user's recent dictations newest-first (timestamp, app, opening text) from the retained history window — a recent window, not an archive: Talkie prunes history per the user's retention setting (default 7 days).

tools.name: read_scratchpad
tools.description: Read the user's Talkie scratchpad — their quick notes and checkbox tasks (done-state shown) — on-device and read-only (Claude reads the scratchpad but never writes it).

tools.name: add_vocabulary_term
tools.description: Suggest a niche/jargon term for the user's dictionary so recognition spells it right — queued for the user to confirm in Talkie with a one-tap Undo (never applied silently).

tools.name: add_replacement
tools.description: Suggest a spoken→written replacement rule for the user's dictionary — queued for the user to confirm in Talkie with a one-tap Undo (never applied silently).

tools.name: remove_replacement
tools.description: Remove a spoken→written replacement rule (by its exact from → to) from the user's dictionary — queued for the user to confirm in Talkie with a one-tap Undo (never applied silently).

tools.name: update_replacement
tools.description: Change an existing replacement rule's target (the rule matched by from/to should produce new_to) — queued for the user to confirm in Talkie with a one-tap Undo (never applied silently).

tools.name: remove_vocabulary_term
tools.description: Remove a niche/jargon vocabulary term from the user's dictionary — queued for the user to confirm in Talkie with a one-tap Undo (never applied silently).
